nodes.name: Reset Circuit Breaker (Admin)
nodes.notes: Emergency administrative kill-switch recovery endpoint. Normal campaign execution and normal circuit recovery do not depend on this endpoint; automatic recovery is health-gated.

nodes.name: Receive Discovery Candidate
nodes.notes: ADDED (Phase -1 integration point). Body: {candidate:{lead_id,campaign_id,email,company_name,domain,contact_name,job_title,discovery_source,email_discovery_source,enrichment_provider,...}} or the lead fields directly.

nodes.name: Receive Finalized Research
nodes.notes: Expects {lead_id, claims:[{claim,source_url,source_type,evidence}], limitations:[...]}. Claim text/evidence should already have passed the injection scrub above; this endpoint additionally re-scans (see Score node).

nodes.name: Generate & QA Draft
nodes.notes: Body: {lead_id, draft_override?: {to,subject,body,needs_review,has_optout,claim_ids}}. draft_override lets an upstream AI-generation step (Phase 6) supply real copy; when absent this flow falls back to the deterministic stub_draft() template exactly as core.py does.

nodes.name: Human Review Decision
nodes.notes: Body: {lead_id, approve: bool, reviewer}. Mirrors human_decide().

nodes.name: Send Lead (Attempt)
nodes.notes: Body: {lead_id, now_dt?}. ATOMIC SEND LOCK -> FINAL SAFETY GATE -> SEND -> DURABLY RECORD -> RELEASE LOCK -> AUDIT chain from core.py send_lead(). Safe to call concurrently (test_L_concurrent: only one of 8 simultaneous callers sends).

nodes.name: Receive Bounce Event
nodes.notes: Body: {lead_id, hard: bool, detail}.

nodes.name: Receive Reply Event
nodes.notes: Body: {lead_id, classification: POSITIVE|NEGATIVE|NO_CONTACT|other}.

nodes.name: Daily Analytics Snapshot
nodes.notes: ADDED (Phase 12). Daily.

nodes.name: Receive Target Prompt (Autonomous Discovery)
nodes.notes: ADDED (Phase -1, Batch 1). Entry point for the Universal Target Prompt (target_industry, target_region, target_persona, target_job_role, company_size, quantity, campaign_id, outreach_objective, desired_cta, email_tone, sender_account, daily_limit, campaign_start_date, campaign_end_date, approved_discovery_sources). Does not discover anything itself: validates the request and generates a search strategy for an external discovery/search provider (EXTERNAL_DEPENDENCY_REQUIRED) to execute. That provider is expected to POST each candidate it finds to /discovery-candidate, tagged with discovery_run_id and campaign_id, where the hardened candidate pipeline (below) and Phase 1+ still apply in full.

nodes.name: Request Feedback & Learning Report
nodes.notes: ADDED (Phase F). On-demand, read-only feedback/analytics report. Body is ignored; any caller-supplied filters are not yet supported (whole-history report only).

nodes.name: Run Final Roadmap Audit
nodes.notes: ADDED (Phase G). On-demand production-readiness / roadmap audit. Read-only.

nodes.name: Receive Autonomous Discovery Status
nodes.notes: Returns current per-run counts from auditable autonomous events; no fabricated completion state.

nodes.name: Autonomous: Discovery Recovery Sweep (Every 10 Minutes)
nodes.notes: Bounded discovery recovery sweep. Workflow remains inactive by default.

nodes.name: Lead & State Controller
nodes.notes: Central authoritative state-transition engine plus hardened Phase 1 intake. All lifecycle-changing controllers request transitions here; intake enforces campaign ACTIVE, global suppression, atomic advisory lock, duplicate protection, and exact lead field mapping.

nodes.name: Research & Draft Controller
nodes.notes: Research evidence is validated for mandatory fields. Research finalization and QA approval request the central state-transition engine; QA PASS cannot bypass APPROVED state.

nodes.name: Send Safety Controller
nodes.notes: Fail-closed queue/final-send safety controller. Final gate re-reads authoritative duplicate, suppression, daily counter, global flags including SYSTEM_ANOMALY, and dependency freshness immediately before atomic reservation/SENDING CAS. FINAL V10 surgical pass: post-provider DB persistence failures durably mark the exact SENDING queue row AMBIGUOUS before optional reconciliation; NOT_SENT reconciliation persists the queue resolution and does not issue a contradictory post-mutation AMBIGUOUS guard transition.

nodes.name: Event & Reporting Controller
nodes.notes: Webhook lifecycle events preserve source distinctions and route lifecycle mutations through the central state-transition engine; positive replies never auto-reply; soft bounces remain record-only.

nodes.name: Autonomous Runtime Controller
nodes.notes: Autonomous discovery remains bounded and uses the normal intake/state pipeline; verified candidates are not privileged direct VERIFIED inserts. Recovery processes every eligible stuck row and never auto-resends AMBIGUOUS outcomes. FINAL V10 surgical pass: autonomous counters use the durable run row for run-owned accounting concepts, and stale TARGET_SENDABLE_COUNT_REACHED runs are eligible for bounded recovery when active send slots fall below target.

nodes.name: Provider & DB Result Controller
nodes.notes: Normalizes provider/database outcomes and feeds the shared deterministic orchestration bus; unknown results fail closed.

nodes.name: DB Gateway
nodes.notes: Single consolidated SQL boundary. Controllers provide parameterized SQL; this node never fabricates missing schema/state and DB errors are fail-closed.

nodes.name: AI Provider
nodes.notes: Preserves the external AI dependency for target understanding and copy generation.
